newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Regulator approves Hong Leong Ind bonus.
newsitem.headline: Regulator approves Hong Leong Ind bonus.

text.p: Malaysian construction and property firm Hong Leong Industries Bhd announced it has received Securities Commission approval to make a bonus issue of two shares for every five held.
It said in a statement it would also make a rights issue in the ratio of one share for every five held at six ringgit per share.

Under the approval, 40 million ringgit of the 168.4 million ringgit raised from the rights issue, would be utilised for the group's expansion in the paper industry, 50 million ringgit in Malaysian subsidiaries and 65 million ringgit for the repayment of bank borrowings.
The company said it has also been allowed to raise 250 million ringgit through an issue of bonds with attached warrants and $90 million in euroconvertible bonds.
Of the proposed bond issue, 240 million ringgit would be used in the paper industry expansion and the rest to repay bank borrowing.

Hong Leong's statement said this translated to around 195 million ringgit, of which 71.4 million ringgit would go towards the company's motorcycle manufacturing and sales operations in China and Germany.
The rest is to be utilised to repay bank borrowings.
